messages.content:
Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Send Tomas a one-line Slack briefing on the fixed Q2 2027 Helio Start paid-test lane. Include the complete approved descriptive result and every excluded claim category, while omitting how the evidence was assembled.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "send_slack_dm", "arguments": {"user": "tomas", "message": "Fixed Q2 2027 Helio Start paid-test lane: approved descriptive result— the cohort ended with 18 paid-active workspaces, $27,860 in refund-adjusted collected cash, support effort of 33 minutes at the median and 116 minutes at the 90th percentile, and five of 25 workspaces above 90 support minutes; excluded claim categories: causal acquisition, scale, pipeline, forecast claims or forecast credit, revenue claims or revenue recognition, claims of support improvement, and executive-language expansion beyond this descriptive claim."}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_100_02", "path": "args", "criterion": "The one-line or equivalently compact message identifies the fixed 25-workspace Q2 2027 Helio Start paid-test cohort and states 18 paid-active workspaces, $27,860 in refund-adjusted collected cash that receives no revenue credit and is not revenue, support effort of 33 minutes at the median and 116 minutes at the 90th percentile, and five of 25 workspaces above 90 support minutes. It excludes causal acquisition, scale, pipeline, forecast, revenue, and support-improvement claims and does not summarize evidence assembly.", "value": {"user": "tomas", "message": "Fixed Q2 2027 Helio Start paid-test lane: approved descriptive result— the cohort ended with 18 paid-active workspaces, $27,860 in refund-adjusted collected cash, support effort of 33 minutes at the median and 116 minutes at the 90th percentile, and five of 25 workspaces above 90 support minutes; excluded claim categories: causal acquisition, scale, pipeline, forecast claims or forecast credit, revenue claims or revenue recognition, claims of support improvement, and executive-language expansion beyond this descriptive claim."}}]}

{"results":[{"check_id":"riley_100_02","passed":false,"reason":"The message includes the cohort results, support metrics, five of 25 count, and excluded claim categories, but it does not explicitly state that the $27,860 collected cash receives no revenue credit and is not revenue; excluding “revenue claims or revenue recognition” is incomplete."}]}
